mentions.description: A personal journalling app built as a passion project, designed for private journal writing without trusting third-party apps or AI integrations that read journal entries.
mentions.problem: Existing journaling apps are disliked and distrusted, and sharing journal writings with AI via integrations (e.g., Google Docs) raises privacy concerns.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building my own journalling app.

I know there are several out there, but I have never liked any of them, and quite frankly never trusted any of them.
